description: Agent Research Lab Records: submit a research lab staff record, the personnel qualification and training file, with its requirements by role and the work and reports signed in the laboratory’s other records: the reading moment; each training or competency the file requires by role with its id, reference, the role (such as laboratory manager or safety officer) and the training; each staff entry with its id, reference and the roles it lists; each training or competency entry with its id, reference, the staff member, the training and the moment it lapses; each signed entry with its id, reference, the staff member who signed, the role it asserts, the record holding it and the moment signed. The signed report gives the staff file and the records behind it, each signed entry against the staff the file lists, each signed entry against the training its role requires on the date of the work, each asserted role against the roles the file lists for the staff member, and each staff member against a current training entry, and counts them, and names divergent research lab staff records: work or a report signed by staff the file does not list, required training or competency lapsed at the date of the work it covers, a role asserted in another record that the file does not support, and a staff member with no current training entry; then a staff entry listing no role or a training entry missing its training or lapse date, and a training entry naming a staff member the file does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No staff entries, or no training entries beside staff, leaves those points unverified. Staff members and entries match by letters and digits, roles and trainings by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, and training is current through the day it lapses. Adult paper only: roles, dates and qualification status from the qualification and training file; this check runs no background check, reads none and reads no staff health data. Verdict researchlab_staff_record_divergent, researchlab_staff_record_partial, researchlab_staff_record_unverified or researchlab_staff_record_consistent. POST /api/researchlab-staff-record-check. Reads the research lab records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it runs no test, accredits no laboratory, inspects no facility, contacts no regulator, accreditor or sponsor and issues no accreditation, certification or approval, which stay with the laboratory, its accreditor and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Research Lab Records reads the research laboratory as an organization, its facility, accreditation, equipment, safety, staff qualification, inspection, incident and operations paper, and never study-level data of any kind: clinical and patient lab records belong to Agent Healthcare, and a clinical or diagnostic laboratory’s records belong to Agent Healthcare even where the same building also does research; animal records belong to Agent Veterinary Records; consent records belong to Agent Consent; research data and datasets belong to Agent Datasets and Agent Evaluation; waste manifests belong to Agent Waste and Recycling Records; grant records belong to Agent Grants; forensic custody belongs to Agent Legal; the sampling-chain method belongs to Agent Water Records; and import, export and government contract records belong to Agent Customs Records and Agent GovCon. It reads no study record, subject record or result value, published or unpublished. The family’s ground is the laboratory’s operations paper trail: whether the facility record matches its accreditation, whether the equipment is in calibration, whether the staff file supports the work signed, and whether the safety, inspection, incident and operations records line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-research-lab-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-research-lab-records/.
